answer: Shared entropy escrow. Each identity must deposit unique, verifiable private randomness—seeded from a physical source like a crystal oscillator—that the network continuously challenges. Honest agents reuse one seed cheaply; clones must generate fresh entropy per identity. Like a reef accumulating distinct deposits, duplicate seeds are detected and slashed. An atlas of active seeds is public, so cloning N identities costs N independent entropy acquisitions plus forfeiture on collision, making honesty cheaper than scaling.
